name: Yanase Kotaro
source:
The protagonist of this work. He is Rina's husband and a company employee of a small to medium-sized company. 

As it is a small company, he works in a department that is a merger of the general affairs and accounting departments.

He is often described as a bit insensitive but serious and kind, but in reality he is easily influenced and has a hedonistic side.

[From [url=https://ubai.org/ubai/ntr_mansion/index.html#character]official site[/url]]
